TRACE_ASSERTIONS.ASSERTION: max_tokens=0 preserves full text and reports was_trimmed=false.
bounded responses include original, shown, saved, and was_trimmed metadata.
style parsing defaults to full and accepts terse.
text_result wraps text content with style, was_trimmed, and token metadata.
cache metadata wraps MCP results with _meta.cache.etag and ttl_secs.
cache keys and ETags ignore _if_none_match and preserve deterministic JSON key ordering.
volatile tools expose ttl_secs=0 and cannot satisfy not-modified cache hits.
